about: What the Laravel admin's code names and what cannot be looked up in this repository, each listed once with the reason. scripts/verify-code-references.mjs fails on a name that is neither defined (in docs/laravel-os/source/ or in this repository's own records) nor listed here, on an entry here without a reason, on an entry the code no longer names, and on an entry that can be looked up after all. The code was taken from woodex420/woodexinterior at commit 603428cca1e45f9da2ffd9c4a0d88eb741285339; no code was changed to make this list shorter.
